target_customer: Cloud first security teams running on AWS that find Splunk and Elastic too costly
problem: Traditional SIEMs are expensive to scale. Matano offers an open source security data lake in the customer's AWS account with detections as code.
business_model: Open source core (Apache 2.0) with a commercial managed Cloud SIEM
product_category: Open source cloud native SIEM and security data lake

founders.name: Samrose Ahmed
founders.background_notes: Grew up in New York City, per YC page.

founders.name: Shaeq Ahmed
founders.background_notes: Worked on data for autonomous robots at Amazon, per YC page.

competitors.name: Splunk
competitors.what: Incumbent SIEM and log analytics, positioned by Matano as costly at scale

competitors.name: Elastic
competitors.what: Elastic Security SIEM built on the Elastic Stack

technical_complexity.rationale: A serverless SIEM on Apache Iceberg and Parquet with log normalization and detections as code, built by two engineers, is hard distributed systems work.

defensibility.rationale: Apache 2.0 licensing allows anyone to copy or fork the code, and well funded SIEM and data lake rivals exist. Deployment inside the customer's AWS account adds some integration lock in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No copy of Matano or acquisition found in sources. Market consolidation news (Cisco and Splunk) did not involve Matano.

market_need_then: SIEM cost at scale and data lake architecture were live themes in 2022 to 2023; the Launch HN post in January 2023 pitched an open source lower cost alternative to Splunk and Elastic.

branding.domain_note: Uses matano.dev, a developer oriented TLD rather than a .com.

identity.visual_style: open source developer project with a GitHub repo

branding.community_and_virality: Launch HN post in January 2023 and the matanolabs/matano GitHub repository with several forks.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive name inside the open source security community through Hacker News and GitHub, but little press about the brand.

outcome_analysis: Matano is a two person open source SIEM company that launched in 2022, joined YC Winter 2023 and posted a Launch HN in January 2023. Aggregators report about 500 thousand dollars raised mostly from the YC deal, and it also offers a managed Cloud SIEM. No exit or shutdown was found. With an Apache 2.0 license and strong incumbents, the commercial outcome is unproven.
notes: Funding is aggregator only: about 500K total (CB Insights), Caplight dates a seed 2023-03-27 and lists Pioneer Fund, Orange Collective, WndrCo and Y Combinator, VCBacked says pre-seed April 2023. None is recorded as a round because no primary source confirms the amount. A Panther open source SIEM (Show HN 2020) existed as a direct peer but its source was not opened, so it is omitted from the list. The company website fetch was rate limited, so current status is inferred from the repo and directory listings. Name origin not found. Completeness pass: one seed dated 2023-03-27 is recorded from Caplight alone, amount null (about 500K is a total from several aggregators, CB Insights dates it 2023-01-01 and Employbl calls it pre-seed). A second search could not confirm Pioneer Fund, Orange Collective or WndrCo, so only Y Combinator is listed. The round rests on a single database. No press release found.
